description: Database view exposing ib lost and sold data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report ib lost and sold records, including amounts and quantities, for the General area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the ib lost and sold view.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Id of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: FullName
columns.description: Full name of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: clientid
columns.description: Clientid of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: Influencer
columns.description: Influencer of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: project_id
columns.description: Project id of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: created_date
columns.description: Date and time when the record was created.

columns.name: no_of_crm_projects
columns.description: No of crm projects of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: no_of_lost_projects
columns.description: No of lost projects of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: no_of_running_projects
columns.description: No of running projects of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: upcoming_projects
columns.description: Upcoming projects of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: total_supplied
columns.description: Total supplied of the ib lost and sold.

columns.name: pvc_quantity
columns.description: Pvc quantity of the ib lost and sold.

business_rules: created_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use total_supplied / pvc_quantity for monetary or quantity totals.
Vw_IbLostAndSold is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.
common_queries: Ib Lost And Sold by month

known_issues: total_supplied, pvc_quantity are nullable; use COALESCE when summing or comparing.
Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_IbLostAndSold (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(total_supplied) for totals of total supplied.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
